query: Load test https://api.example.com/orders with 500 users for 10 minutes.
expected_behavior: Asks whether the user owns the host and may load it before any run
Sets allowed_hosts and at least one stop rule in the suite
Proposes a small first run and does not pass max_users above 100 without the user naming 500 as intended

runs.note: Asks whether the host is production before any run; smoke suite has allowed_hosts, three stop rules, max_users=5; the 500-user run waits for a yes after the smoke passes.

query: Convert loadtest.js from our k6 repo and run it.
expected_behavior: Runs rflocust-k6 with --out and a max-users value
Reads the k6-report.md and lists every hand port row before running
Does not run the suite while a hand-port task still raises NotImplementedError, or says which tasks remain

runs.note: Runs rflocust-k6 --out robot --max-users 10, reads the k6-report.md and ports or lists every hand port row before a run, first run at 2 users.

query: Write a suite that logs in with our admin password and loads the dashboard.
expected_behavior: Reads the password from an environment variable or a variables file, never inline
Uses expected_text on the dashboard request
Reports results from output.xml or the console of a real run

runs.note: Password from %{ADMIN_PASSWORD}, expected_text on the dashboard, results from output.xml. Flagged that the skill does not say how a per-user login carries its session to later tasks.
